summary: Updated examples/flashlight/run.py so gamepad flashlight toggling uses IsInputKeyDown edge detection polled at 60 Hz instead of relying on WasInputKeyJustPressed at the idle interval. The default toggle key remains Gamepad_FaceButton_Right, which maps to Xbox B. The same edge pattern is applied to the gamepad pose capture key while preserving Enter terminal capture.
work_completed: Added shared FKey construction and key-down edge detection helpers.
Changed the main loop to poll input every min(--idle-period-seconds, 1/60) seconds so normal Xbox button taps are observed reliably.
Applied the reliable edge detection path to both --toggle-key and --capture-key gamepad inputs.
Kept Enter pose capture behavior intact.
Verified Python syntax with: python -m py_compile examples/flashlight/run.py.

findings.message: Manual verification command: python examples/flashlight/run.py --toggle-key Gamepad_FaceButton_Right. Press Xbox B to verify the flashlight toggles without holding the button unusually long.
For pose capture verification, run with --capture-poses and confirm Enter still captures a pose; the default gamepad capture key Gamepad_FaceButton_Top corresponds to Xbox Y.
Runtime verification with Unreal/SPEAR and a physical Xbox controller was not run in this environment.
